messages:
nora_sre: Quick postmortem follow-up thread for GPU capacity + autoscale remediation. I'll track owners + dates here. Short list.

ashley_platform: I'll run the scheduler backoff + staggered warmup experiment on staging. Plan: backoff=1.2, prewarm=1, scaleDownDelay=80s.

devon_scheduler: I'll own the quota-floor request for dedicated eu-central. Suggest +4 GPUs (2 immediate, 2 in 14 days). Draft PR by Mon.

maria_capacity: I will run headroom sims including partner-sync spikes. Sharing CSV and recommendation by Sun EOD.

ben_oncall: Ops will add a one-page emergency scale playbook and a shortcut to trigger warmup-job. ETA: tomorrow.

sam_ops: I'll coordinate a short runbook run with oncall and document rollback knobs.

lee_finance: Please include an estimated monthly delta in the PR so I can fast-track approval.

infra-bot: Created INF-4809: "Scheduler backoff experiment" (owner: ashley_platform) | due 2024-07-10

nora_sre: Owners + due dates we agreed:
- scheduler experiment @ashley_platform due 2024-07-10
- quota-floor PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-12
- headroom sim @maria_capacity due 2024-07-07
- emergency playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-06

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 36h with health gates: no >7% regression in 99th and <0.5% error increase. Will post canary job link.

devon_scheduler: PR link will include staggered grant and alerts for headroom crossing 80%.

maria_capacity: Early sim insight: partner syncs create short tails; smoothing windows reduce peak GPU need by ~1-2 units. Will recommend schedule shift if gains >20%.

ben_oncall: Playbook snippet:
```
# emergency warmup
/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-eu-central --units=2
# verify jobs healthy, notify routing team
```

nora_sre: Follow-ups: (1) if headroom sim favors schedule shift, coordinate with partners to move syncs; (2) ensure finance sign-off path is in PR. Tag @lee_finance.

sam_ops: I'll draft partner communication template for schedule change.

lee_finance: Happy to review numbers once attached. Fast track if schedule shift reduces steady-state spend.

infra-bot: Created INF-4810: "Quota-floor PR review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-12

nora_sre: Thanks everyone — keep links to PRs, canary logs, and the headroom CSV in this thread. Recheck in one week.
